convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the 'Stalin' custom indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all position open/close logic. The custom indicator has 10+ parameters and its buffer values drive all signals, requiring the Stalin indicator source to fully replicate signals in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of selected timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade entry timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA operates

other_exits: When both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no close signal detected on current bar, EA scans historical bars forward from SignalBar+1 to find the earliest opposite signal and sets close flag accordingly

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. Positive MM value is interpreted as percentage for margin-based modes; as fixed lot size when MMMode=LOT.

custom_logic_notes: The Stalin custom indicator is a composite signal combining MA and RSI elements. Buffer 1 (UpValue) produces buy signals; buffer 0 (DnValue) produces sell signals. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates signals on every tick (not just new bars). There is a 'recount' mechanism: if CopyBuffer fails, Recount is set true and the signal evaluation is retried on next tick. The EA also has a lookback scan (lines 129-155) that searches forward through historical bars to find the earliest opposing close signal when both open and close flags are enabled for a side but no close was triggered on the signal bar - this prevents staying in a trade when the indicator already flipped in a prior bar. Signal time is set to last bar date + timeframe seconds, effectively marking the open of the next bar for entry timing. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all actual order placement/closing logic including position checking within those functions.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or port the Stalin custom indicator since it drives all signals. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must be ported to Python - it encapsulates BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose with margin mode logic. The MarginMode conditional sizing needs careful implementation (5 modes). The historical bar lookback scan for close signals (lines 129-155) is non-standard and must be preserved. SignalBar parameter shifts which bar is evaluated for signals; SignalBar=1 means previous bar, SignalBar=0 means current bar with intrabar re-evaluation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 pips are very large suggesting 5-digit broker (100.0/200.0 real pips) - verify digit adjustment in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
